assets.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in an ochre courtyard lounge. A blonde woman in a pale cropped top and teal skort hugs a seated braided woman in rust red from behind. Opposite them, a woman in an Eritrea-inspired red, green and blue flag mini clasps hands, while a fourth in midnight blue leans in from a higher bench. Jade boots, rainbow ankle boots, varied heels and an IA upper-arm tattoo are visible.

AI-generated fashion portrait of four fictional adult women leaning together in a close seated conversation beside blue coastal water. A braided woman in sea blue clasps the hands of a blonde woman in ivory. Two companions in jade and an Eritrea-inspired flag mini lean in at different heights. Star clasps, agency, scorpion and silent king tattoos decorate the fashion scene. Distant fires and mushroom-shaped smoke clouds are imaginary scenery, not a real event.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a sheltered desert lounge. A blonde woman in a red-and-blue flag-inspired mini embraces a seated braided companion from behind. Two women in copper and terracotta lean in and clasp hands at different heights. Rainbow-gradient legwear, metallic platform boots, glossy heels and fine line compass-and-heart tattoos complete the outfits. The dunes and lounge are fictional scenery.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a diagonal lake-window lounge composition. A braided woman in cobalt holds hands with a blonde woman in a red-and-blue flag-inspired cropped outfit and mini skirt. A green-clad companion leans over the bench, while a silver-and-cobalt-clad woman touches a shoulder from a separate seat. White RAZE boots, rainbow platform sandals and crescent tattoos are visible. The calm mountain lake setting is fictional.
